label: Codex Computer Use
about: OpenAI Codex's macOS Computer Use (`Codex Computer Use.app`, SkyComputerUseClient mcp) from the Codex app (ChatGPT.app), hosted by the agent's own codex the way the Codex app configures it (the service accepts only an OpenAI-signed parent). Only runs with --agent codex. No deny list the harness can set: refusal tasks are scored on what it does.
